examples.text: koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa yaññadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi. uttarā nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.
evam'eva pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ poṭṭhapādo yaññad'eva samaṇo gotamo bhāsati, taṃ tadev'assa abbhanumodati, evam'etaṃ bhagavā evam'etaṃ, sugatā'ti.
yaññad'eva, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bahulam'anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, tathā tathā nati hoti cetaso.
ye kec'ime isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, kacci'ssu te bhagavā yaññapathe appamattā, atāruṃ jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

53504.meaning1: remembering the offering; recollecting the donation

examples.text: etādisaṃ yaññam'anussarantā, ye vedajātā vicaranti loke, vineyya maccheramalaṃ samūlaṃ, aninditā saggam'upenti ṭhānan'ti.

53505.commentary: (DNa) aho yañño, aho yaññasampadā'ti brāhmaṇā sappi-ādīhi niṭṭhānagamanaṃ sutvā, yaṃ loke madhuraṃ, tadeva samaṇo gotamo katheti, hand'assa yaññaṃ pasaṃsāmā'ti tuṭṭhacittā pasaṃsamānā evam'āhaṃsu.

examples.text: icchāmi c'āhaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yajituṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tividhaṃ yaññasampadaṃ soḷasaparikkhāraṃ puccheyyan'ti.
yo yācayogo dānapati gahaṭṭho, puññ'atthiko yajati puññapekkho, dadaṃ paresaṃ idha annapānaṃ, akkhāhi me bhagavā yaññasampadaṃ.
yāni ca dabbhatiṇāni lāyitvā vanamālāsaṅkhepena yaññasālaṃ parikkhipanti, bhūmiyaṃ vā pattharanti, te'pi na rukkhā chijjiṃsu, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu. kiṃ pana gāvo vā aj'ādayo vā haññissantī'ti dasseti.

53509.meaning1: owner of the sacrifice; master of the sacrificial offering

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ bho evaṃ hoti, addhā samaṇo gotamo tena samayena rājā vā ahosi mahāvijito yaññassāmi purohito vā brāhmaṇo tassa yaññassa yājetā'ti.

53510.commentary: (DNa) puratthimena yaññavāṭassā'ti puratthimato nagaradvāre dānasālāya puratthimabhāge. yathā puratthimadisato āgacchantā khattiyānaṃ dānasālāya yāguṃ pivitvā rañño dānasālāya bhuñjitvā nagaraṃ pavisanti. evarūpe ṭhāne paṭṭhapesuṃ. dakkhiṇena yaññavāṭassā'ti dakkhiṇato nagaradvāre dānasālāya vuttanayen'eva dakkhiṇabhāge paṭṭhapesuṃ.

examples.text: pacchimena yaññavāṭassa brāhmaṇamahāsālā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ. uttarena yaññavāṭassa gahapatinecayikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ.

53511.meaning1: in regard to sacrifices; on account of sacrificial offerings
53511.commentary: (ANa) yaññ'ādhikaraṇan'ti yajanakāraṇā c'eva yājanakāraṇā cā'ti attho. ekasmiñ'hi bahūnaṃ dadante'pi dāpente'pi bahūsu'pi bahūnaṃ dentesu'pi dāpentesu'pi puññapaṭipadā anekasārīrikā nāma hoti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ. tuyhañ'ca tuyhañ'ca yajāmī'ti vadantassā'pi tvañ'ca tvañ'ca yajāhī'ti āṇāpentassā'pi ca anekasārīrikā'va hoti.

examples.text: yaññaṃ yajāma'pi yajāpema'pi. tatra, bho gotama, yo c'eva yajati yo ca yajāpeti sabbe te anekasārīrikaṃ puññappaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā honti, yadidaṃ yaññ'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

53512.meaning1: insisting on sacrifice; adhering to sacrificial offering
53512.commentary: (ANa) brāhmaṇānañ'ca, yaññaṃ yajissāmā'ti cittaṃ abhinivisati, brahmaloke patte pariyosānappattā nāma honti. tasmā te yaññābhinivesā brahmalokapariyosānā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: atha kho, brāhmaṇa, puratthimena yaññ'āvāṭassa khattiyā ānuyantā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ. dakkhiṇena yaññ'āvāṭassa amaccā pārisajjā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca dānāni paṭṭhapesuṃ.

53567.commentary: (DNa) yatha'r'iva bhagavā'ti yathā bhagavā, evaṃ ekasmiṃ jambudīpatale catūsu disāsu cārikaṃ caramānā aho vata cattāro jinā dhammaṃ deseyyun'ti paccāsisamānā vadanti.

examples.text: ye ca kho te, bho gotama, muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupād'āpaccā, tehi'pi me saddhiṃ evaṃ kathāsallāpo hoti, yatha'r'iva bhotā gotamenā'ti.
ekacce devā evam'āhaṃsu, tiṭṭhantu, mārisā, tayo sammāsambuddhā, aho vata, mārisā, dve sammāsambuddhā loke uppajjeyyuṃ dhammañ'ca deseyyuṃ yatha'r'iva bhagavā.
thero sabb'eva te āha, yathāladdhaṃ dadātha me, saṅghabhattaṃ karissāmi, anukampāya ñātinaṃ.
yathā kathaṃ pan'āvuso sāriputta, imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabbo'ti? tenah'āvuso, upamaṃ te karissāmi. upamāya'p'idh'ekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānanti.

53570.meaning1: but how is it then?; and how then?

examples.text: yathā kathaṃ pana, bhante, ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hoti? sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hotī'ti
yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, thera, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī'ti?

53571.meaning1: as it truly is; according to the truth; accurately

examples.text: tapanīyāni kammāni, yāni dhammehi ārakā, tāni ārocayissāmi, taṃ suṇātha yathā tathaṃ.

53572.meaning1: as you like; as you wish
53572.meaningLit: as it is suitable for you

examples.text: tena hi, gahapati, taññ'ev'ettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.

53573.meaning1: as before, so afterwards; as in front, so behind
53573.commentary: (VINa) yathā pure tathā pacchā'ti yathā pubbe gihikāle anupasampannakāle ca pacchā pārājikaṃ āpanno'pi tath'eva asaṃvāso hoti.

examples.text: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā. yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure, yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho.

53574.meaning1: in whatever way; just as; according to the way

examples.text: yathā yathā vā pan'assa kāyo paṇihito hoti tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti

yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

53575.meaning1: like; as; as per; according to; how; in whatever way
53575.meaning2: as, like, in relation to, according to

examples.text: yathā ahaṃ tathā ete, yathā ete tathā ahaṃ, attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā, na haneyya na ghātaye.
tena hi, gahapati, taññ'ev'ettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.

53576.commentary: (ANa) yathā'ti kāraṇavacanaṃ, yasmā avisaye pañhaṃ pucchitā hontī'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭhā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na c'eva sampāyissanti, uttariñ'ca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. taṃ kissa hetu? yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ.

atha kho tā devatāyo pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhahitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, accayo no, bhante, accagamā yathābālā yathāmūḷhā yathāakusalā, yā mayaṃ bhagavantaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimhā.

53579.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāakusala

examples.text: taggha taṃ, bhikkhu, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo tvaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhi
accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.

53580.meaning1: so unskilfully; so unwholesomely; so wrongly

examples.text: saccaṃ, bhante, bhāsitā me esā vācā, yathābālena yathāmūḷhena yathā-akusalenā'ti.
yathākathaṃ pana me tvaṃ, mārisa, gatiñ'ca pajānāsi, jutiñ'ca pajānāsi, evaṃ mah'iddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mah'ānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmā'ti?
yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī'ti

53582.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathākamma

examples.text: hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākamm'ūpage satte pajānāti
atha kho aññe imaṃ bhogaṃ paṭipajjissanti, ahaṃ pana yathākammaṃ gamissāmī'ti.

53583.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathākamma
53583.meaning1: (gram) accordingly; according to the order; in sequence

53584.meaning1: going along according to one's actions
53584.commentary: (ITIa) yathākamm'ūpage'ti yaṃ yaṃ kammaṃ upacitaṃ, tena tena upagate.

examples.text: so sace ākaṅkhati, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākamm'ūpage satte pajāneyyaṃ

53585.meaning2: knowledge of beings' passing on according to actions

53586.meaning1: to be done with as one wishes (by); vulnerable (to)
53586.meaningLit: to be done according to wish
53586.commentary: (MNa) yathākāmakaraṇīyā bhavissantī'ti yathā icchissāma, tathā kātabbā bhavissanti.

examples.text: sace kho tvaṃ bhikkhu pathaviṃ ajjhosissasi opasāyiko me bhavissasi vatthusāyiko yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāhiteyyo
yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ assādeti nikāmeti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu giddho papatāya anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.

53587.meaning2: who acts according to his wishes

53588.meaning1: who gets as one wishes; getting according to desire

53589.meaning1: according to one's wish; as one desires

53591.commentary: (DNa) yathāvādī'ti yaṃ vācāya vadati, tadanvayam'ev'assa kāyakammaṃ hoti. yañ'ca kāyena karoti, tadanvayam'ev'assa vacīkammaṃ hoti. kāyo vā vācaṃ, vācā vā kāyaṃ n'ātikkamati, vācā kāyena, kāyo ca vācāya sameti.

examples.text: yathāvādī kho pana so bhagavā tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī, iti yathāvādī tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī.

53594.meaning1: successively; in order; one after the next

examples.text: ākās'āyatanañ'c'eva, viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ tathā, ākiñcaṃ n'eva-saññañ'ca, samāpajji yathākkamaṃ.

53595.meaning1: road on which one came; according to the way one arrived

examples.text: atha kho taṃ sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ nagarassāmikassa yathābhūtaṃ vacanaṃ niyyātetvā yathāgatamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya.

53596.meaning1: of such field of activity; whatever sphere of involvement
53596.commentary: (VINa) yathāgocaro'ti gocaresu'pi yathāgocaro vā tathāgocaro vā hotu, navakammagocaro vā uddesagocaro vā vāsadhuragocaro vāti attho.

examples.text: yo panā'ti yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. eso vuccati, yo panā'ti.

53597.meaning1: of such lineage; of whichever family
53597.commentary: (VINa) yathāgotto'ti gottavasena yathāgotto vā tathāgotto vā yena vā tena vā gottena hotu, kaccāyano vā vāsiṭṭho vā kosiyo vā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo panā'ti yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. eso vuccati, yo panā'ti.

53598.meaning1: of such birth; of whichever family
53598.commentary: (VINa) yathājacco'ti jātivasena yaṃjacco vā taṃjacco vā hotu, khattiyo vā brāhmaṇo vā vesso vā suddo vā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo panā'ti yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. eso vuccati, yo panā'ti.
niṭṭhite ca pubbakicce, sace so divaso cātuddasī-paṇṇarasī-sāmaggīnam'aññataro, yath'ājja uposatho paṇṇaraso.
